newsitem.title: UK: BA appoints new revenue management head.
newsitem.headline: BA appoints new revenue management head.

text.p: British Airways Plc said it had appointed Aleks Popovich as head of revenue management effective April 1.
The company said in a statement that Popovich would be responsible for optimising the airline's profits.
Popovich is currently general manager network management at British Airways World Cargo. In his new post, he will replace Ray Lyons, who is taking up a post outside BA.
BA chief executive Bob Ayling said Popovich's promotion "demonstrates the commitment we have of promoting our key people from within the airline". -- London Newsroom +44171 542 7717
